evidence.decision: Distinguishes direct action, binary state and launch destination with authoritative completion/remote state and locked-device security decisions.
evidence.artifact: Delivers surface/configuration/state/authentication contract and revised control binding rather than a static colored icon.
evidence.transformation: Garage example replaces immediate false Open, leaked home name and stale remote state with authenticated pending/confirmed behavior and redaction.
evidence.verification: Checks remote changes, failure, reconfiguration, lock and symbol-only meaning; false state, missing authentication or disclosure fails.
evidence.applicability: Qualifies symbol-only Lock Screen, capture-only locked camera transition and TV/Watch/visionOS exclusion; security enforcement requires native evidence.
evidence.handoffs: Widgets handles information, Live Activities handles bounded progress and Privacy handles exposure only when relevant.
evidence.distinctiveness: Authoritative remote state and lock/authentication behavior distinguish system Controls from ordinary buttons.
